summary: Sasol Ltd filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on July 21, 2026. The filing is a routine submission of an attached document and does not contain any substantive disclosure regarding a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change. The filing appears to be a periodic report or general corporate update with no material event triggering a special-situations classification. It is classified as a routine current report for a non-US issuer.
